Grade: Grade 7
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.1: Buddhist Practices the Buddha triple gem precepts meditation sharing of merits.

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Buddhist Practices the Buddha triple gem precepts meditation sharing of merits.. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do daily scheduled practices benefit society?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practice the Buddhist scheduled religious practices in daily life
2. appreciate the benefits of the Buddhist daily scheduled practices for harmonious living
